original_test_intent: Verify the Serial Number of the intended SMBIOS Type 3 enclosure exactly matches the protected chassis asset record and remains unchanged after reboot, distinct from system and baseboard serial numbers.
original_method: Capture all Type 3 structures in an access-controlled evidence store, select the target enclosure by type/BOM/asset context, compare its Serial Number with the protected chassis inventory, reboot and repeat without exposing the identifier.
manual_activity: A user authorizes the protected serial reference, target enclosure and reboot plan. Core secure collection and exact comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Identifier format, placeholder and redaction policy
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and store raw serial evidence only in the approved protected location.
Do not echo the chassis serial into chat, general logs or commit content.
Do not substitute Type 1 system or Type 2 board serial and do not assume the first Type 3 record.
Reject blank, placeholder, duplicate and wrong-enclosure identifiers.
Stop on exposure, mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect protected all-Type-3/tool/BOM evidence, select the enclosure and perform access-controlled pre/post serial comparisons with redacted reporting.
Do not modify DMI, disclose identifiers or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the protected chassis inventory reference, enclosure mapping and evidence policy.
Resolve serial ownership/provisioning discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Type 3 is correct, but inline grep output risks identifier exposure, loses enclosure provenance, hides errors and relies on insecure credential/host-key handling.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved authenticated transport, write complete Type 3 output directly to protected storage, bind the target record and compare serials inside that boundary with only redacted status exported.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 3 Serial Number scope, chassis script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture the target Type 3 record inside an access-controlled evidence path, bind it to enclosure/BOM identity, validate format and exact equality to the protected inventory, and publish only a redacted comparison result plus digest/provenance if policy allows.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, enclosure and inventory revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Approved asset-inventory/evidence-handling policy and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds data protection, enclosure-record identity and placeholder rejection while preserving the original field.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Protected inventory reference and evidence policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Hashes may still be sensitive or correlatable; use them only if explicitly approved.

project_override_considerations: A project may define its serial format or an approved unprovisioned state, but must identify the enclosure and keep raw values protected; it cannot accept any non-empty serial.
expected_evidence: Approval, protected serial reference, enclosure mapping and tool version
Protected raw pre-reboot Type 3 plus redacted comparison result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Type 3 item and persistence criterion consistently target the enclosure Serial Number.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The field is clear and safely readable with protected handling; missing reference/storage affects readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains Type 3 collection but replaces exposed grep output with protected, enclosure-scoped evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps sensitive-data controls and recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds explicit identifier non-disclosure, placeholder/duplicate rejection and redacted result boundaries.

review_improvement: Prevents the wrong serial layer or enclosure from passing and prevents sensitive chassis identity from leaking through routine command output.
independent_technical_reasoning: With authorized protected inputs, every core operation is software-controlled; evidence sensitivity and engineer verdict ownership affect safeguards, not automation classification.
